notes: Obby tower names the genre and the shape in two words: Obby & Platformer on course-tower, which routes the genre-wide P6 plus P2 for platforms sitting directly above each other up the tower. Took the Tower Obby preset whole and added obstacle-jump and obstacle-moving to cover the ten short distinct obstacle sections the answers describe as simple and playful. Nothing here needed a user: I assumed a checkpoint at each of the ten stages, since staged is how Roblox players describe a tower with per-stage restarts, and read the summit as the winner-zone payoff. The candy colouring is theming that the image pass carries, not a layout feature, so it produced no options of its own.
